item.title: Nvidia VP Denies Resignation Letter as 84,000 Petition for Huang's Return
item.description:
Nvidia VP of Applied Deep Learning Research Bryan Catanzaro publicly denied signing a letter demanding former CEO Jensen Huang's reinstatement, calling it fabricated and voicing support for the board and interim CEO Colette Kress. The fake letter copied the OpenAI staff petition template, yet a separate online petition for Huang's return has gathered over 84,000 signatures, signaling lingering divisions after the leadership change.

原文标题：英伟达高管辟谣逼宫信 8.4 万人请愿黄仁勋回归

Why it matters：英伟达高层变动引发伪造联名信与大规模请愿，是观察这家 AI 算力核心公司治理走向的重要信号。

item.title: Claude and Arduino Help 32-Year-Old Jeep Pass Emissions Test
item.description:
US AI enthusiast Mohammad Zulali used Claude for diagnosis and Codex for coding, paired with a $3 Arduino Nano, to read data from the aging engine computer of a 1994 Jeep Cherokee and tune fuel parameters until the 32-year-old vehicle passed California emissions testing. Total electronics cost under $15, and the project is open-sourced as xj-scanner under GPLv3.

原文标题：Claude 与 Arduino 联手让 32 年老车通过排放检测

Why it matters：一个具体可复现的 AI 辅助硬件逆向与诊断案例，展示了 LLM 在老旧系统改造中的实际价值。

item.title: Ex-Anthropic Researcher Says Retraining Mythos Now Needs Fraction of Original Compute
item.description:
Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon says a chart shown during Anthropic's IPO roadshow reveals super-exponential gains in algorithmic efficiency, meaning Mythos could now be retrained with a fraction of its original compute. He argues for a one-year pause on frontier model development to let competitors catch up.

item.title: Cursor Discloses Supply Chain Attack Affecting Up to 5,000 Users
item.description:
Cursor released its investigation into an October security incident in which attackers used leaked Fireworks keys to steal data from a shared storage bucket, then leveraged internal credentials to inject a tampered Claude Code extension into the Cursor marketplace. The malicious build stayed live for about 11 hours and affected up to 5,000 users; fewer than 0.05% of non-privacy-mode users had agent trace data exposed, and Cursor has notified affected customers and rotated credentials.

原文标题：Cursor 披露供应链攻击调查结果 最多波及 5000 用户

Why it matters：这是 AI 编程工具首次公开的完整供应链攻击复盘，对依赖扩展生态的开发者具有直接的安全警示价值。

item.title: First US AI Music Awards Crown Virtual Artist Xania Monet
item.description:
The first US AI Music Awards took place in Los Angeles, with virtual artist Xania Monet sweeping Artist, Song and Album of the Year; her track 'How Was I Supposed to Know?' became the first AI-artist song to enter Billboard's radio airplay chart. Nominees stressed that lyrics and prompt tuning are human-driven, arguing AI music should be treated as a new genre.

item.title: Cloudflare Open-Sources Kitesurf Agent Browser With Lower Resource Use Than Chromium
item.description:
Cloudflare open-sourced Kitesurf on November 13, a browser built specifically for AI agents that runs on Cloudflare Workers and handles HTML parsing, CSS application, JavaScript execution and page screenshots without any Chromium process or container. Cloudflare says it targets agent-centric metrics such as token consumption, context window, scalability and cost, and consumes significantly less CPU and memory than Chromium on tasks like screenshots and HTML extraction, enabling higher-concurrency agent workloads.

原文标题：Cloudflare 开源智能体浏览器 Kitesurf 资源消耗低于 Chromium

Why it matters：主流云厂商开源面向智能体的轻量浏览器引擎，直接降低网页自动化智能体的算力与成本门槛。

item.title: Runway Open-Sources Praxis-1 Robot Control Model
item.description:
Runway has released Praxis-1, its robot control model, with open weights and source code under Apache 2.0. Trained on video and robot data, it maps camera images, text instructions and position data to robot motions, and can be adapted to new robot bodies via additional training. It still confuses similar-looking objects and cannot yet reliably plan complex action sequences on its own.

原文标题：Runway 开源 Praxis-1 机器人控制模型

Why it matters：视频生成厂商将视频预训练能力迁移至具身控制并完整开源权重与代码，是具身智能开源生态的重要增量。

item.title: Jensen Huang Exits Nvidia as Wall Street Bets AI Boom Endures
item.description:
Jensen Huang's departure as Nvidia CEO triggered a brief 14% stock plunge, yet Wall Street largely expects the AI investment boom to continue, with Broadcom and AMD seen as beneficiaries. Analysts point to sustained compute demand and hyperscaler commitments through 2027 as near-term support, while Huang's sprawling circular investment network across AI startups may loosen.

item.title: Intel Forms K-AI Full-Stack Alliance with 23 Korean Firms
item.description:
Intel announced at its Seoul AI Summit the formation of the K-AI Full-Stack Alliance with 23 Korean companies spanning server manufacturing, NPU design, foundation models and cloud services, aimed at building sovereign and open AI infrastructure for the Korean market. Intel also publicly showed its D270 data-center inference accelerator, claiming 26,200 TFLOPS of FP4 compute at 350W and advantages over Nvidia's RTX 6000 Pro in Gemma latency, agent performance and financial simulation.

item.title: Fed Governor Barr Warns Rapid AI Adoption May Widen Income Inequality
item.description:
Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr warned in a Yale speech that rapid AI adoption could worsen income inequality in the near term, especially if a handful of AI firms dominate the market and concentrate gains among their executives and shareholders. He urged policymakers to build safeguards now, while adoption is still relatively early.

item.title: Pearl Abyss Expands AI Across Its Entire Game Development Pipeline
item.description:
Crimson Desert developer Pearl Abyss confirmed in its earnings report that it is extending generative AI from repetitive-task automation, content assistance and testing optimization to its entire development pipeline, while stressing that core gameplay and content creation remain human-led. The studio presses ahead despite a player backlash over AI-generated assets in the game's launch build.

item.title: New Zealand Retailer Faces Worker Protests Over AI Bathroom Monitoring
item.description:
More than 300 workers at The Warehouse, New Zealand's largest retailer, protested at its Auckland and Christchurch distribution centers over AI-driven efficiency monitoring and picking robots, with the union alleging bathroom-time surveillance led to incontinence incidents. The company denied using AI to track toilet breaks, saying the scanning technology only measures work efficiency, and insisted drone-based inventory checks did not cause layoffs. The dispute highlights the friction between warehouse automation and worker privacy and job security.

原文标题：新西兰零售商 AI 监控如厕时间引发 300 人抗议

Why it matters：这是 AI 监控落地引发劳资冲突的典型案例，涉及算法管理边界与员工隐私，值得行业关注。

item.title: Tsinghua Unveils ProtCell Foundation Model for Single-Cell Proteomics
item.description:
Tsinghua University's Jiang Rui research group has released ProtCell, a foundation model for single-cell proteomics pretrained on roughly 380 million cells across 98 public datasets, capable of mapping cell states and inferring unmeasured protein expression to support drug discovery and virtual-cell construction. The paper also reports a full pretraining reproduction on Moore Threads' MTT S5000 accelerator, with key quantitative metrics deviating only about 0.2% from mainstream international GPU platforms.

原文标题：清华发布单细胞蛋白组基础模型 ProtCell

Why it matters：国产算力卡完成前沿生命科学基础模型全流程预训练复现，是 AI4S 与自主算力生态的双重信号。

item.title: Foundation Says Robots Will Fight Most Wars Within a Decade
item.description:
Mike LeBlanc, co-founder of Foundation, a robotics company backed by Eric Trump, predicts that humanoid robots, ground vehicles and drones will handle most major combat missions within five to ten years. The company has delivered two Phantom MK-1 units with roughly 40 kg payload capacity, and its next-generation MK 2 stands about 1.83 meters tall, can lift an adult and mount heavy machine guns.

item.title: TCL CSOT Ramps Printed OLED Line to 9K Substrates Monthly
item.description:
TCL CSOT CEO Zhao Jun said the Wuhan t12 printed OLED line has scaled from 3K to 9K large substrates per month, with first-product yield rising from single digits to about 70% since April mass production, and multiple products now in volume manufacturing. Printed OLED deposits organic materials via inkjet printing, offering higher material utilization and greener production than vacuum evaporation, marking a notable process shift in display manufacturing.

原文标题：TCL 华星印刷 OLED 产线产能提升至 9K 大板

Why it matters：印刷 OLED 从试产走向产能与良率爬坡，是显示制造工艺路线的重要产业进展。

item.title: Google Teamwork Multi-Agent System Formalizes Weil Conjectures
item.description:
Google has expanded its Antigravity multi-agent system into Teamwork, a Gemini-powered framework that pairs parallel specialist agents with independent critic and reviewer agents. It formalized the Weil conjectures in roughly 1.8 million lines of Lean code across about 28,800 sub-agent calls, reproduced a formal proof on finite-time blowup for the 3D Navier-Stokes equations, and delivered verifiable results in molecular structure identification and a C++ to Rust rewrite of its libgav1 decoder.

原文标题：谷歌多智能体 Teamwork 完成韦伊猜想形式化证明

Why it matters：多智能体协作首次在顶级数学形式化与真实工程任务上给出可验证成果，是智能体系统能力边界的重要节点。

item.title: Microsoft AI Veteran Exits After 14 Years Citing Neglect of Efficiency Research
item.description:
John Langford, a Microsoft AI scientist and co-founder of the AI Frontiers lab with over 14 years at the company, has left, citing that his cost-reduction research such as Full-Bandwidth Transformer was not seriously considered by Microsoft AI. The work showed a 1B-parameter model can approach the performance of a conventional model trained on ~1.5x more data, and ByteDance Seed's Recycler later adopted a similar hidden-state reuse approach to outperform models 2-3x larger. The departure highlights a strategic rift between scaling and exploring new methods.

原文标题：微软 14 年 AI 老将离职 称降本研究未获重视

Why it matters：核心 AI 研究者的离职与路线分歧，折射大厂“堆规模”与“降本创新”的张力，对关注模型效率的读者有实质参考价值。

item.description:
Elon Musk, citing Cloudflare data, said agent-generated internet traffic has already surpassed human traffic and forecast it will reach 1,000 times human levels within five years, calling even that estimate too low. The claim points to a structural shift in internet infrastructure and traffic patterns as agents browse autonomously at scale.

item.title: COMAC's 10-Ton Electric Aircraft Completes First Crewed Flight
item.description:
COMAC's 10-ton electric commercial aircraft CE-25A completed its first crewed intelligent flight in Binzhou, Shandong, carrying two pilots and one flight-test engineer with all systems nominal. Following its uncrewed first flight in February 2026, the milestone shifts validation toward pilot-in-the-loop human-machine collaboration closer to real commercial operations. The aircraft uses distributed electric ducted fans across the wings and 500 Wh/kg condensed-matter batteries, seats 19 with a 400 km range, and has had its type certificate application accepted by the CAAC.

原文标题：中国商飞 10 吨级电动飞机完成有人驾驶首飞

Why it matters：国产电动商用飞机从无人验证迈入有人驾驶在环阶段，是低空经济与航空电动化的重要工程节点。

item.title: Rivet 推出 OpenOrange 兼容 Workers 且成本降 4.8 倍
item.description:

Why it matters：为受限于 Workers 运行时与计费模型的团队提供了可迁移的开源替代路径，成本量级与部署形态值得关注。

item.title: 多智能体协作需主会话与子任务双层结合
